Pritika Engineering Components Limited PRITIKA : Issue of Securities Ref: Issuance of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants on a Preferential Basis

 We would like to inform that the members of the company, at the 9th Annual General Meeting of the company held on Thursday, 17th September, 2026 at 10.30 am at its Registered Office: Plot No. C-94, Phase-VII, Industrial Focal Point, S.A.S. Nagar, Mohali, Punjab, 160055 by passing special resolutions have approved: 

1.	Issuance of up to 50,00,000 Equity shares at an Issue Price of Rs. 64 per share (i.e. on premium of Rs. 59 per share) on Preferential basis, upon conversion of outstanding unsecured loan into equity, to Pritika Auto Industries Ltd, the person belonging to 'Promoter & Promoter Group'.
2.	Raising of funds through issuance of upto 12,00,000 equity shares at an Issue Price of Rs. 64 per share (i.e. on premium of Rs. 59 per share) on preferential allotment basis to the investors - non-promoter, (Public) category for cash.
3.	Raising of funds through issuance of upto 4,00,000 warrants at an Issue Price of Rs. 64 per warrant, each warrant convertible into one equity share of Face Value of Rs. 5 each (i.e. on premium of Rs. 59 per share), on Preferential Allotment basis to the Non-promoter, (Public) category for cash.

It is further informed that the Voting Results was declared on today i.e. 18th September, 2026 after receipt of Scrutinizer Report on the result of voting.

VIP Industries Limited VIPIND : Outcome of Board Meeting VIPIND : VIP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board its meeting held today, i.e., Friday, September 18, 2026, has, inter alia, approved the proposal for raising funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding &#8377; 500 crores (Rupees Five Hundred Crores) during FY 2026-27, in one or more tranches. The funds may be raised through the issuance of equity shares having a face value of &#8377; 2 each and/or debt securities, convertible securities, depository receipts (ADR/GDR), FCCBs, warrants, preference shares or other eligible securities or any other financial instrument (hereinafter referred to as  Securities ). 

VIP is back on the growth path after several quarters; the proposed fund raise will further accelerate Company s ongoing growth initiatives, funding of working capital and enhancing capabilities that will support long-term value creation. These investments aim to reinforce the company's market leadership and position it to capture emerging growth opportunities in the luggage and travel ecosystem.

The proposed fund raising may be undertaken through one or more permissible modes, including but not limited to a public issue, rights issue, qualified institutions placement, debt issue, preferential issue or any other permissible mode and/or combination thereof as may be permitted under applicable laws, subject to receipt of such statutory, regulatory, shareholders', stock exchange, and other approvals, permissions, and sanctions as may be required.
